entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: An optimistic plane of invention, brightly colored, where artifacts like thopters, automatons and constructs are part of daily life.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The magical energy that inhabits the space between planes, concentrated and abundant on Kaladesh as a life-giving resource.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh with the neighborhoods Greenwheel, Bomat and Weldfast.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A Planeswalker whose home plane is Kaladesh.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An ingenious aether scientist of Ghirapur.

entities.name: Gremlins
entities.description: Creatures of Kaladesh that gorge on aether and wreck intricate thopters.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane whose artifacts were integrated with organic material, contrasted with Kaladesh.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gray, gloomy plane contrasted with Kaladesh's bright look.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane inspired by mythos of the distant past, contrasted with Kaladesh's living-culture inspiration.

relations.note: Ghirapur is the city of the plane whose neighborhoods this page lists.
relations.quote: this is when the city of Ghirapur acquired its neighborhoods
